preconditions.description: The integer n representing the path length is between 2 and 1,000,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: len(path1) == n - 1 and all(c in 'NESW' for c in path1)
preconditions.description: The first path string has length n-1 and consists only of characters 'N', 'E', 'S', 'W'.

preconditions.expression: len(path2) == n - 1 and all(c in 'NESW' for c in path2)
preconditions.description: The second path string has length n-1 and consists only of characters 'N', 'E', 'S', 'W'.
